summary: Ocoee should retain its standalone municipal control row. Official city materials show a live Ocoee Police Department, FDLE's 2020 county-and-municipal report publishes Ocoee as a normal municipal agency, and FDLE's 2021 report retains a named Ocoee row even though the offense cells are blank. The current all-fill condition is therefore not contract policing, county replacement, or target invalidity; it is an official-publication continuity gap after the last usable 2020 statewide row, with no public FDLE FIBRS or FBI incident-based backfill for 2024.
